answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, our protocol pairs recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments with a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function. Attackers face a negative expected utility due to staking collateral requirements and severe slashing penalties that enforce a robust Nash equilibrium. We test the physical resilience of the hardware nodes using ivory cases, saffron fibers for thermal shielding, and velvet insulating layers to mitigate side-channel leaks, ensuring unforgeable identity generation.
